captions.detailed: A pair of aviation pilot binoculars featuring two parallel cylindrical objective tubes connected by a central bridge. The entire body is finished in a matte black rubberized texture, with dark blue reflective glass lenses on both the front objectives and rear eyepieces. Each eyepiece is equipped with a textured, ridged focus ring designed to rotate continuously for independent focus adjustment.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of aviation pilot binoculars with two main cylindrical tubes, a connecting bridge, and textured eyepiece focus rings. Ensure the eyepieces are modeled as independent components with continuous rotation joints, and apply a matte black material to the body with dark blue glass lenses.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first defining a central bridge using a box primitive. Two main objective tubes are created using stepped cylinders, which are offset from the center. Ridged focus rings are modeled by patterning small rectangular or cylindrical teeth around a cylinder. These components (bridge, left/right tubes, and focus rings) are organized into separate parts, with continuous rotational joints defined between the main tubes and their respective focus rings.
